basics.name: Aritrika Karmakar
basics.label: Business Development Representative (BDR) · Outbound Lead Generation & CRM Ownership · HubSpot · Salesforce · LinkedIn Sales Navigator · 2+ Years

summaries.default: Accomplished Business Development Representative with 2+ years driving outbound lead generation, CRM ownership and cross-functional collaboration with sales teams. Took ownership of a CRM platform rollout from the ground up and delivered a 45% increase in audience engagement across a 100,000+ contact database at Inmisceo.

work.name: Inmisceo
work.domainNote: Technology/training company building learning-technology tools for corporate training providers.
highlights: Led CRM platform selection and setup, enabling scalable marketing automation and GDPR-compliant data structures from the ground up.
Supported lead generation initiatives through multi-channel marketing campaigns across email, LinkedIn, website and industry events, contributing to pipeline growth and customer acquisition.
Collaborated closely with sales and leadership teams to qualify marketing-generated leads, coordinate follow-up activities and support product demos and webinars.
Optimised lead nurturing pathways using open, click-through, and conversion rate analytics, resulting in a 45% increase in audience engagement.
Managed CRM activities in HubSpot, maintaining audience segmentation, automated workflows and accurate customer records across a 100,000+ contact database.
Ensured campaign QA, UTM tracking accuracy, and delivered monthly CRM campaigns to 100K+ contacts with high QA standards and GDPR compliance.

work.name: Goldsmiths, University of London
work.domainNote: University careers service — career planning, employability workshops and events for students.
highlights: Supported CRM-led digital campaigns reaching 50,000+ users, driving engagement and awareness across student-focused communications.
Represented Goldsmiths on student panels and delivered talks sharing experiences at on-campus recruitment and widening-participation events (e.g. taster days, school visits).
